channel.title: GOLFRAW
channel.description: Golf news without the press-release language. Evidence first, opinion labeled.

item.title: Scottie Scheffler and Ted Scott: How They Find the Number | GOLFRAW
item.description: He passed Hovland for good with a birdie at the 16th. What goes into that club decision, and the rule stopping your rangefinder doing it for you.

item.title: Hovland's Tour Championship Runner-Up and What He Said | GOLFRAW
item.description: He led the field in putting by six strokes and still said his ceiling was nowhere close. The misses that cost him, and the coach he's gone back to.

item.title: Michael Block's Ally Challenge: A 36-Hole Record, Then 74 | GOLFRAW
item.description: He set the tournament's 36-hole scoring record, led by two, then shot 74. Why a T3 is still the best result of his senior career, and what it buys him.

item.title: The End of LIV Golf? What a Bankruptcy Would Really Mean | GOLFRAW
item.description: Chapter 11 isn't liquidation. It's the vehicle for handing the league to players at about a third of the purses. What's verified, what isn't.

item.title: Scheffler and Brandel Chamblee: The Full 2026 Arc | GOLFRAW
item.description: In April he didn't recognise Scheffler's swing. In August he called him miles ahead. Both takes were right, and the record proves it.

item.title: Scott O'Neil's LinkedIn Post on LIV Golf 1.0, Fact-Checked | GOLFRAW
item.description: Players as majority owners, five continents, a billion homes. Every claim checked against what LIV actually did in 2026, including the purse cut.

item.title: Scottie Scheffler's Final Press Conference Answer of the Season
item.description: He'd just won $10 million, a second FedEx Cup, and passed Tiger Woods on the all-time money list. Then he spent his last answers of the year talking about wind and about travelling with his kids.

item.title: LIV Golf Settlement Offers: Cents on the Dollar, Explained | GOLFRAW
item.description: Take a fraction now and join a smaller league, or hold out and queue as an unsecured creditor. What the offers say, and who's waiting on the answer.

item.title: LIV Golf Bankruptcy: What Chapter 11 Would Actually Do | GOLFRAW
item.description: A Chapter 11 filing isn't the league shutting down. It's the vehicle for handing it to the players. What's verified, what isn't, and who gets paid last.

item.title: Scottie Scheffler's Swing: The Foot Slide Is a Symptom | GOLFRAW
item.description: Most of the famous foot slide happens after the ball has gone. What's actually producing 1.694 strokes gained tee to green is duller and copyable.

item.title: Hovland on What Makes Scheffler Successful, in 8 Words | GOLFRAW
item.description: Asked if Scheffler amazes him, the man he'd just lost to said no. His actual explanation is duller and far more useful than any mental-game theory.

item.title: Tour Championship Points and Payouts: All 29 Checks | GOLFRAW
item.description: Scheffler took $10M, seven men split $11.95M, and $355,000 went nowhere. Full table, plus the figure two official pages disagree on.

item.title: Tiger Woods' Career Money List Record May Fall Today | GOLFRAW
item.description: Scheffler needs solo 13th, McIlroy needs solo 4th. One outlet already declared it done a week ago. Here's what's actually verified and what isn't.

item.title: Why Pros Are Ditching Hybrids, and Why You Shouldn't | GOLFRAW
item.description: Hybrid use in the PGA Tour top 100 fell from 32% to 13%. On the LPGA it's 70%. The 15 mph gap explains both, and one man won a major with one.

item.title: Michael Block Leads the Ally Challenge Into Sunday by Two | GOLFRAW
item.description: He's in on an invitation, his son is on the bag, and he opened Saturday with an eagle. What Block actually needs from Sunday, and it isn't the trophy.
